adrs.title: All trackable work lives in the event-sourced hub
adrs.context_md: Task state scattered across chat logs and READMEs goes stale, cannot be audited, and cannot gate a deploy.
adrs.decision_md: Every trackable entity (task/adr/feat/gap/cap/deploy/note) lives in the hub event log under PROJECT/.hub; 'done' is granted only by the lease-owned complete endpoint against a result note and evidence. Real execution is the default proof. Only a rare critical-boundary task declares a transient out-of-band probe; its receipt persists, its test artifact does not, and the hub never executes the command itself.
adrs.consequences_md: One source of truth; completed receipts compose upward, and observed failures return as fresh repair work instead of imposing speculative checks on every task.

tasks.title: Wire the hub into the project and open the live board
tasks.acceptance: The mounted Hub opens and accepts the first real project task through its normal workflow.

tasks.title: Record the first real feature task with concrete acceptance
tasks.acceptance: A new task names the real outcome to ship and creates no test work unless it crosses a rare critical boundary.
